==Mithral Full Plate of Speed==

There are 2 versions of this item, only 1 currently drops in chests.
* Current version: [[Item:Mithral Full Plate of Speed (Striding version)|Mithral Full Plate of Speed (Striding version)]]: Melee Alacrity 10%, Striding 15%
* Historic version: [[Item:Mithral Full Plate of Speed (Haste version)|Mithral Full Plate of Speed (Haste version)]]: Haste 2/day
